source: docs/design/ozmap-replication-2026-10-24/expressibility-review.md (commit 34f612e), fresh Opus reviewer, before any learner call
domain_common: one record text in the ops.md grammar after the D2 input policy (one terminal LF or CRLF removed), parseable by field (segments separated by '; ', one '=' per segment, unique keys, values without ';', '=', CR or LF), every numeral the operation reads within the interpreter input limits (at most 38 digits, at most 12 fractional digits)

verdict.inputs: the job's own resolved text; fields grade, yield, uts
verdict.guards: exact equality with unknown; grade membership in the five table labels decided by equality before any table access; unit read from the second space separated piece and the numeral parsed with that exact unit; missing fields and malformed records abstain through field
verdict.domain: common domain; grade any label, yield and uts each a numeral with unit MPa or N/mm2, or unknown
verdict.reasons: a fixed five row table plus two inclusive comparisons: exact string equality, lookup over at most 32 literal entries, exact decimal parsing with an exact unit suffix and inclusive le; no multiplication, division or iteration

margin.inputs: the job's own resolved text; fields yield, uts
margin.outputs: string: an integer, one space, MPa, or unknown
margin.guards: exact equality with unknown for each field; unit selection and exact unit parsing as for verdict
margin.domain: common domain; yield and uts each a numeral with unit MPa or N/mm2, or unknown
margin.reasons: one exact subtraction and a fixed format: fmt with 0 places and unit MPa rounds half to even, emits no decimal point, keeps the sign and suppresses negative zero

elong.outputs: string: one decimal place, one space, %, or unknown
elong.domain: common domain; gauge and final numerals with unit mm (gauge positive), or unknown
elong.reasons: (final - gauge) / gauge * 100 divides by a per record value; the language has add and sub only and fmt rounds half to even where the contract asks half away from zero; the gauge 50 carve-out was rejected as not the contract domain

temp_class.inputs: the job's own resolved text; field temp
temp_class.guards: exact equality with unknown; unit selection and exact unit parsing as above
temp_class.domain: common domain; temp a numeral with unit C or degC, or unknown
temp_class.reasons: two inclusive thresholds on one exact decimal: t < 10 is not le(10, t) and 10 <= t <= 35 is two le tests
